title: After Closing Time
style: Jazz ballad with brushed drums, walking upright bass, muted trumpet, and late-night piano comping at an easy swing; verse stays sparse and conversational, pre-chorus opens with rising chord changes and soft sax answers, chorus blooms with close harmony and a smoky trumpet line. Lead vocal is intimate and breathy with light doubles on key phrases, ad-lib scat tags between lines, and a short horn call at each turnaround. Vinyl crackle, room-tone swells, and subtle ride-cymbal shimmer bridge sections. Warm, intimate, and slightly glossy., jazz
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You know I miss my train
Every time the room gets loud
I let the glass go cold
And disappear inside the crowd

Your name taps on the bar
Like a coin against the tile
I fold it into smoke
And stay a little while

[Pre-Chorus]
Spin me past the door
Past the bills and bitter news
Past the face I wore today
Till I remember how to move

[Chorus]
Take me where the sax can hide me
Take me where the night goes soft
I want that sweet escape
I want to drift and drift and drift
Take me where the sax can hide me
Where the hurt gets washed in blue
Play me out of here
Till I feel like someone new

[Verse 2]
The waiter knows my trick
How I pay and never stay
I make a whole new life
In every chorus that I play

Your laugh falls off the wall
Like rain through a cracked screen door
I chase it with a solo
Then I ask for one encore

[Pre-Chorus]
Spin me past the door
Past the bills and bitter news
Past the face I wore today
Till I remember how to move

[Chorus]
Take me where the sax can hide me
Take me where the night goes soft
I want that sweet escape
I want to drift and drift and drift
Take me where the sax can hide me
Where the hurt gets washed in blue
Play me out of here
Till I feel like someone new

[Bridge]
Let the trumpet bend
Let the piano lie
Let the whole room sway
Till the heavy parts untie

I don't need forever
I just need tonight
A little room to vanish
A little room for light

[Chorus]
Take me where the sax can hide me
Take me where the night goes soft
I want that sweet escape
I want to drift and drift and drift
Take me where the sax can hide me
Where the hurt gets washed in blue
Play me out of here
Till I feel like someone new
